responsibility: This file implements RTL-specific helpers for GCC’s checking-build selftest framework. It provides assertions for structural and pointer equality of RTX values with useful dump output on failure, the rtl_dump_test RAII helper that loads an RTL function dump and cleans up global function state afterward, and a small insn-by-UID search helper used by RTL parser and simplification tests. Its responsibility is shared testing support for RTL-focused selftests rather than core RTL functionality.
same_name_distinction: Implements the RTL selftest support declared in selftest-rtl.h, such as RTX equality assertions with dump output, rtl_dump_test setup/cleanup around read-rtl-function, and UID-based insn lookup; the header provides the macros, class declarations, and prototypes.
